brandVoice: Clear, calm, specific; no exaggerated claims.
name: Qoop — 28 Ekim 2026 açıklama standardı
customSizing: Send your wall width and height; we can adjust this design to fit your measurements at no extra cost.
printingInks: Water-based HP Latex inks (UL GREENGUARD Gold certified inks).
careInstructions: Wipe clean with a soft, damp cloth; suitable for humid rooms such as bathrooms and kitchens.

materials.name: Textured Traditional
materials.details: Textured matte, wallpaper paste applied (paste not included). Best choice for rough or textured walls; also suitable for smooth walls.

materials.name: Textured Peel and Stick
materials.details: Self-adhesive textured matte finish. Repositionable during installation and removable; ideal for renters. Best on smooth painted walls. Cannot be reused once removed.

materials.name: 3M Vinyl Smooth
materials.details: Smooth self-adhesive 3M vinyl with sharp print detail. Also works on glass, wood and plastic. Needs a perfectly smooth surface. Cannot be reused once removed.

processing: 5-7 business days. Every order is printed after you place it and checked before it ships.
surface: Wait at least 15 days on freshly painted walls. Surface must be clean, dry and dust-free.
toolkit: Numbered panels, felt-edged smoother, utility knife, masking tape and step-by-step installation guide.
returns: Damaged or print fault: send clear photos; once confirmed, free replacement. Printed to order; returns cannot be accepted once applied. Check your order before installing.
